learning_outcomes.text: Know the theoretical foundations of vibration theory.
Gain insight into the interaction of force and motion in mechanical systems and machines.
Ability to formulate and solve machine dynamics problems using computational and experimental methods.
Apply mathematical methods confidently to problems in machine dynamics.
Evaluate and discuss simulation results and know the possibilities and limitations of the methods.

syllabus_topics: Signal description tools in the time, frequency, and probability domain
Vibration differential equation with one degree of freedom, free and forced vibrations
Translational, torsional, and bending vibrations, vibration isolation, unbalance, vibration damping
Systems with multiple degrees of freedom, introduction of matrix notation, analogies
Construction of a computational model, discretization, characteristic value determination, reduction of degrees of freedom
Natural vibrations and modes, simulation programs
Practicum on signal analysis, experimental and analytical simulation of dynamic processes using commercial software
Discussion and evaluation of models and results
assessment_rules: Laboratory exercises, upon successful presentation of results, can lead to bonus points for the examination performance. A maximum of 10% of the points achievable in the exam can be credited as bonus points.
